title: Small Business Bookkeeping Spreadsheet, Google Sheets and Excel Profit and Loss Template, Income Expense Tracker, Mileage Log, Tax Set Aside
description:
Not sure if your business is actually making money? This Small Business Bookkeeping Spreadsheet shows your profit in seconds: log your income and expenses, and your Profit & Loss statement, dashboard and quarterly tax set-aside update automatically.

WHO IT'S FOR
Self-employed people, sole proprietors and small service businesses: cleaning companies, handymen and contractors, salons, photographers, freelancers, consultants and online sellers. Works in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

WHAT YOU GET
1 spreadsheet file (.xlsx) with 8 tabs:
1. Start Here - quick setup guide
2. Setup - business name, tax set-aside %, mileage rate, up to 10 income and 25 expense categories
3. Income - log every payment with client, category and payment method (drop-downs); the month fills in automatically
4. Expenses - log every purchase with vendor, category and deductible Y/N
5. Mileage - log business trips; the deduction is calculated with your rate
6. Profit & Loss - monthly and year-to-date statement by category, net profit and margin
7. Dashboard - income, expenses, net profit, tax to set aside, monthly chart, top expense categories
8. Quarterly Tax - estimated amount to set aside each quarter, paid / to pay status

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Fully automated formulas: enter transactions, everything else is calculated
- See your real profit and margin every month
- Know how much to keep aside for taxes, before the deadline
- Up to 1,500 income and 1,500 expense lines per year
- Sample data included so you see it working right away

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the file after purchase
2. Open it in Google Sheets (upload to Drive, then Open with Google Sheets) or in Excel 2016 / Microsoft 365
3. Enter your business details and categories in Setup
4. Log income and expenses, check your Dashboard and Profit & Loss

GOOD TO KNOW
- Digital download, nothing is shipped
- Requires a free Google account or Microsoft Excel 2016+
- Amounts display in US dollars by default; change the cell format to use your currency
- Quarterly due dates shown are the usual US federal dates; tax rules vary, check with your accountant
- This is a bookkeeping tool, not tax, legal or accounting advice
- For use in your own business, no resale
- Due to the digital nature of this product, returns are not accepted. Message me with any question!
